limitations.note: The rewrite fixed the write increment but also used next-state Gray pointers and registered status flags, changing the cycle-by-cycle timing of wfull and rempty that the one-line fix preserves.
The rewrite also gated RAM access with reset, whereas the original and correct fix leave RAM enables controlled by the request and status flags.

The test checked status after allowing several extra cycles and used the DUT's own flags to decide which transfers to score, so it could verify FIFO ordering without detecting the changed flag timing.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted. Use a safer approach
limitations.note: The cleanup command caused the entire first simulation attempt to be rejected, so the testbench had to be submitted again.
